name: EventCalendar
label: Event calendar
description: A month, a week or a day of events: pills on their days, overflow counts in the month, a legend that can filter, and a panel for the chosen day.

props.name: events
props.description: The events to place on the grid, including any that fall on the visible leading and trailing days of the neighbouring months.

props.name: month
props.description: Shown month (YYYY-MM) for controlled use. Pair with `onMonthChange`.

props.name: defaultMonth
props.description: Initially shown month (YYYY-MM) for uncontrolled use. Defaults to the current month.

props.name: onMonthChange
props.description: Fires with the newly shown month (YYYY-MM) after prev/next navigation.

props.name: maxEventsPerDay
props.description: Event pills shown per day before the rest collapse into "+N more".

props.name: onEventClick
props.description: Fires with the clicked event. Pills only render as buttons when this is set.

props.name: onDateClick
props.description:
Fires with the clicked day (YYYY-MM-DD) — from anywhere on the cell, the
day number, and the "+N more" overflow row. The number and overflow row
only become buttons when this is set, and cells only take their pointer
cursor and hover feedback with it.

props.name: selectedDate
props.description:
Marks this day (YYYY-MM-DD) as the selected one — the action-colour chip
on its number, taking precedence over the today chip. Controlled by the
consumer; pair with `onDateClick` to move it.

props.name: today
props.description: The date the calendar treats as today (`YYYY-MM-DD`): it carries the today chip and picks the month shown first. Defaults to the device's date; pin it for a demo, a test or a time zone the device is not in.

props.name: legend
props.description: What each event colour means, shown as a row of dots and labels under the grid. With `legendToggles`, each entry also shows and hides its colour's events.

props.name: legendToggles
props.description: Makes each legend entry a selectable Chip that shows or hides the events of its colour, so a reader can narrow a busy calendar by kind.

props.name: hiddenColors
props.description: The colours whose events are hidden, for controlled use. Pair with `onHiddenColorsChange`.

props.name: defaultHiddenColors
props.description: The colours hidden to begin with, for uncontrolled use.

props.name: onHiddenColorsChange
props.description: Fires with the hidden colours after a legend entry is switched.

props.name: legendLabel
props.description: The name of the legend's set of toggles, when `legendToggles` is on.

props.name: renderSelectedDay
props.description:
Draws a panel for the selected day under the grid, in every view: handed
the day (YYYY-MM-DD) and its events as shown, it returns what the panel
holds (a list of the day's events, a form to add one). Shown only while
`selectedDate` is set.

props.name: actions
props.description: Trailing header slot, e.g. a "New event" Button.

props.name: view
props.description: `month` shows the whole month, a day's overflow folded behind "+N more"; `week` shows one week in tall cells with every event, stepping a week at a time from the selected day's week (else today's), which it keeps as its own state after mount; `day` shows that one day the same way, stepping a day at a time.

props.name: previousLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the previous-month button.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the next-month button.

props.name: previousWeekLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the previous-week button, in the week view.

props.name: nextWeekLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the next-week button, in the week view.

props.name: previousDayLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the previous-day button, in the day view.

props.name: nextDayLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the next-day button, in the day view.

props.name: showLessLabel
props.description: The visible text of the control that folds an expanded day back, when a day's "+N more" opens it in place (with no `onDateClick`).

props.name: monthLabel
props.description:
The month heading, given the first day of the month in view: the visible
title and the name of the day grid. Defaults to the month name and the
year in `locale` ("January 2026" in `en-US`). Month view only; the week
view's heading is the week's range in `locale`.

props.name: overflowLabel
props.description:
Accessible name of a day's "+N more" overflow button, given the number of
hidden events and the day. Defaults to "N more events" followed by the
full date in `locale`.

props.name: moreLabel
props.description:
The visible text of a day's overflow row, given the number of hidden
events. Defaults to "+N more". The row's accessible name is
`overflowLabel` when it is a button.

props.name: weekdayLabels
props.description:
The weekday headers above the grid: seven entries, Sunday first, laid
out from `weekStartsOn`. Defaults to the short weekday names in `locale`
("Sun" to "Sat" in `en-US`), or its narrow names where the short ones
are whole words (Arabic); a list of any other length falls back to the
default.

props.name: locale
props.description:
The BCP 47 locale the calendar is written and laid out in, such as
`de-DE`: the month heading, the weekday names, the spoken dates and the
first day of the week. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else
`en-US`.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description:
The first column of the grid, 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday). Defaults to
the first day of the week in `locale`: Sunday in `en-US`, Monday in
`de-DE`.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

EventCalendarLegendItem.description: A colour the calendar's events use, and what it means, for the legend.

Weekday.description: A day of the week as `Date.getDay()` numbers it: 0 is Sunday, 6 is Saturday.
